subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Should OpenClaw add a core provider-family fallback contract for model failover, and if so should the contract be wildcard/auto refs, explicit fallbackFamilies, catalog-derived fallback, or another single shape?
rationale: This changes public model/config semantics and provider failover behavior; AGENTS.md explicitly treats fallback and config-surface expansion as product decisions, and the related implementation paths are not equivalent.

options.title: Define one core contract
options.body: Choose one canonical provider-family fallback API, reject live openai-codex routes in favor of openai/*, and require schema/runtime/docs/tests to land together.

options.title: Adopt catalog-derived fallback only
options.body: Use the narrower fallbacksFromModels idea as the supported direction, but keep this issue open until the PR is reworked and proven against the broader provider-family expectations.

options.title: Keep explicit fallbacks only
options.body: Decide that automatic provider-family fallback is not a core behavior and document that users should maintain explicit fallbacks or use plugin policy hooks for dynamic routing.

recommendation.title: Define one core contract
recommendation.body: Choose one canonical provider-family fallback API, reject live openai-codex routes in favor of openai/*, and require schema/runtime/docs/tests to land together.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest current routing candidate from blame/history on the fallback resolver and config policy surface.
